scope: Post-hoc descriptive DEV quality by observed threshold 0.45 K; already-scored predictions only
limitations: Cutpoints chosen after seeing DEV results; all bins including empty reported
Observed K depends on image and is not randomized; bin differences do not prove causal effect of K
Small strata and same-data exploration; no significance or generalization claims
No new labels, new model calls, actual timing or equal-compute claim
